analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($55.86) vs SMA5 ($56.31)/SMA20 ($57.38)/SMA50 ($57.18): below short/mid-term trends, bearish diagnosis.
· Position vs SMA100 ($54.83)/SMA200 ($53.45): above long-term trends, strength maintained.
· 52-week position (74.9%) + current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.3→37.0) + entering oversold territory + strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1740→-0.2619) + continued worsening + bearish trend confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $55.78) + 5.56% band width suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($55.45) + testing support as 5-day low is renewed.
· Swing resistance ($55.89) + short-term bounce expected on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (potential Lower Low) + downtrend continuation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.96x) + moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 45 and MACD histogram improvement confirmed.
